urteile.grund: Confirms the propagated kein_standard. This is the composite place and date at which the holder signs the confirmation («Die Richtigkeit der oben erwähnten Angaben bestätigt: Ort und Datum»). It is not an address or a register date. I searched the whole catalogue of 290 standards. Element names place*, sign*, confirm* and declar* found only civil-status places (placeOfBirth, placeOfDeath, placeOfMarriage, placeOfOrigin in eCH-0011/0020/0021), placeOfWork (eCH-0021/0119), real-estate placeName (eCH-0129/0131/0206/0211), the GEVER signer and openingDate in eCH-0039, the eCH-0260 signatures container (apprenticeship contract only), and message-header dates. The signature standards eCH-0091/0220/0230/0250/0274/0282 have no elements. None of these is a container for a signing place and date. In the corpus, all 31 judged «Ort und Datum» fields are kein_standard.

The place where the holder signs the confirmation. It is not a postal address, so eCH-0010 town does not fit. It is not a civil-status event either, so placeOfBirth, placeOfDeath and placeOfMarriage do not fit, and placeOfWork and placeName mean something else. I searched place*, town*, sign* and confirm* across all 290 standards and found no signing-place element. This matches the 11 earlier verdicts on «Ort und Datum»/Ort, which are all kein_standard.

The date on which the holder signs the confirmation. I searched *date* together with sign*, confirm* and declar* across the catalogue. openingDate in eCH-0039/0147 is the opening date of a GEVER document or dossier. messageDate and modificationDate in eCH-0039/0058/0090/0147 belong to message headers. dateFrom in eCH-0010 is an address period. No element means the date of a signature. This matches the 11 earlier verdicts on «Ort und Datum»/Datum, which are all kein_standard.

The handwritten signature of the vehicle holder. I searched the whole catalogue: titles Signatur and Unterschrift, and element names sign*. eCH-0039 signer is a GEVER metadata token that names the signer; it is not the signature itself. eCH-0260 signatures and hostCompanySignatureConfirmation are booleans in the apprenticeship contract only. eCH-0091/0220/0230/0250/0274/0282 deal with the technique of electronic signatures and have no elements. This matches all 70 judged signature fields in the corpus, which are kein_standard.

The composite in which the traffic expert records technical defects on the Hilfsblatt, point 4 («Beurteilung vor dem Hintergrund, dass die Nachprüfung bis 6 Jahre ausgedehnt wird»). I searched these catalogue titles: Fahrzeug, Verkehr, Motor, Prüf, Kontroll, Befund, Zulassung, Polizei, Expert, Gutacht. I also searched these element names: vehicle*, inspect*, defect*, deficien*, finding*, corros*, chassis*, motor*, remark*. The only standards near this topic have no elements and a police scope: eCH-0281 Datenaustausch Polizei – Individualverkehr (In Arbeit) and eCH-0051 Basis-Datenkatalog Polizei/Justiz. The vehicle elements in eCH-0119/0276 are tax data. No container exists for inspection findings. This matches the sibling fields on this Formular, Beanstandungen Fahrgestell/Unterbau and Karosserie/Lackierung, which are kein_standard.

A free-text line, with a tick box, for one technical defect the expert found. The search of the whole catalogue (vehicle*, inspect*, defect*, deficien*, finding*, remark*, comment*) found no element for a vehicle inspection finding. The comment and remark elements in eCH-0058/0211/0260 belong to message headers, building reports and apprenticeship contracts. eCH-0281 has no elements and covers police data exchange. This matches the parts Korrosion and Weitere Beanstandung on this Formular, which are kein_standard.

The composite for vehicle modifications that the expert finds were not yet reported or registered (Motor/Getriebe/Luftfilter/Auspuffanlage/Räder/Aerodynamische Anbauteile, «Zutreffendes unterstreichen»). It is an inspection finding, not a register value. The modif* elements in the catalogue are only header or record metadata: modificationDate in eCH-0039/0058/0147, registerModification in eCH-0116, recordModification in eCH-0206. I also searched vehicle*, chassis*, motor* and inspect*, and the titles Fahrzeug, Verkehr, Motor, Prüf, Zulassung and Polizei. eCH-0281 (In Arbeit) and eCH-0051 have no elements and a police scope. No standard fits.
